cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：优先事项
cards.example_zh: 安全是我们的首要任务。

cards.example_en: Maths no longer scares her because of steady progress.
cards.example_zh: 因为进步稳定，数学不再让她害怕。

cards.example_en: People of every race cheered at the school concert.
cards.example_zh: 学校音乐会上，各个种族的人都在欢呼。

cards.example_en: Walking to school can reduce the family's fuel costs.
cards.example_zh: 步行上学可以减少家里的油费开支。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：跑；奔跑
cards.example_en: I run around the playground before morning class.
cards.example_zh: 上午上课前，我绕着操场跑步。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：计划；方案
cards.example_en: The new bike scheme lets students borrow cycles cheaply.
cards.example_zh: 新的自行车方案让学生能便宜地借车。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：得分；分数
cards.example_en: My score on the listening test went up by ten marks.
cards.example_zh: 我听力测试的分数提高了十分。

cards.example_en: The search for my lost keys took the whole evening.
cards.example_zh: 寻找丢失的钥匙花了整整一个晚上。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：秘密的
cards.example_en: She wrote the secret message in tiny letters.
cards.example_zh: 她用很小的字写下了那条秘密信息。

cards.example_en: Please throw the garbage into the bin.
Quiet music can calm your soul before a big exam.
cards.example_zh: 大考之前，安静的音乐能让灵魂平静下来。

cards.example_en: Table tennis is the sport he practises with his dad.
cards.example_zh: 乒乓球是他和爸爸一起练习的运动。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：状态；州
cards.example_en: In its solid state, water becomes ice in the freezer.
cards.example_zh: 水处于固态时，放进冰箱就会变成冰。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：发臭味
cards.example_en: Those old shoes stink after a rainy football match.
cards.example_zh: 那些旧鞋在一场下雨的足球赛之后发臭。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：严格的
cards.example_en: Our strict teacher checks homework at the start of every lesson.
cards.example_zh: 我们严格的老师每节课开始时都会检查作业。
